messages:
maria_marketing: Hey @runtime, we're finalizing the webinar slide deck. Need validated benchmark numbers for MPT-30B (tag mpt-30b@2026-02-11) quantized with q4_1.
Specs: p95 latency and cost per 1k tokens for seq lengths 512 and 2048. Provide cold-start and cache-warm (after 50 prefix requests). Please include raw logs, aggregate CSV, and the exact run config. Can you do a focused rerun by Tue EOD? :pray:

alex_runtime: Got it. We'll run 2 seq lengths x cold/warm x 3 runs each on dedicated-small. Confirming quant recipe q4_1 and runtime v1.9.2. Do you want the prompt set you used for previous marketing runs or a fresh curated list?

maria_marketing: Use the marketing prompt set (taylor uploaded). We want a short explanation of any caveats in the CSV. If any run shows >2x p95 from baseline, flag and don't use those numbers.

taylor_pm: Uploaded prompts to s3://redwood-bench/marketing/prompts/2026-03-mpt30b-marketing-40.json. It's a mix of short chat turns, brief code-gen, and summarization.

sam_qa: I'll attach a golden-subset (10 examples) sanity check and run automated diffs. If outputs diverge beyond threshold we'll block the number. Want screenshots of a couple sample outputs for slides?

maria_marketing: Yes, two representative responses and the golden-diff results.

bench-bot: Job queued: bench-webinar-1770025432 (matrix: 512/2048 x cold/warm x 3). Estimated run time ~2.5h. Artifacts -> s3://redwood-bench/webinar/2026-03-mpt30b-q4_1/<run-id>/

alex_runtime: Running on dedicated-small (A100). Run config: runtime=1.9.2; hardware=dedicated-small-a100; concurrency=8; batching_policy=auto; metrics=prometheus,csv,raw_logs; artifact_retention_days=14.

alex_runtime: Run-1 complete. Summary (aggregates CSV uploaded): seq=512 cold p95=118ms cost_1k=$0.34; seq=512 warm p95=95ms cost_1k=$0.28; seq=2048 cold p95=435ms cost_1k=$1.12; seq=2048 warm p95=355ms cost_1k=$0.93. Link: s3://redwood-bench/webinar/2026-03-mpt30b-q4_1/aggregates-run1.csv

maria_marketing: Thanks — those look close to our targets. Please run the remaining jobs and keep an eye out for any autoscaler activity. Note any excluded windows in the caveats.

bench-bot: Run-2 complete. Minor noise on one warm run (short scale-up flagged and excluded). Aggregated CSV updated.

alex_runtime: Uploaded final aggregated CSV with caveats cell: noted a ~30s autoscaler scale-up during one warm-run (excluded). Also excluded one run where p95 spiked >2x due to infra jitter. Raw logs + perf CSVs at the artifact path.

sam_qa: Golden-subset diffs attached. No semantic regressions beyond tolerances. Added screenshots: slide-sample-1.png and slide-sample-2.png in artifacts.

maria_marketing: Excellent. Can you also add a one-line plain-English caveat for the slide CSV (e.g., "Numbers measured on dedicated A100 pool; warm path measured after 50-prefix warmup; one warm-run excluded due to autoscaler event").

alex_runtime: Done. CSV has caveat cell and run metadata. Marking this job complete.

maria_marketing: Great — locking numbers for rehearsal Wed morning. Thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:

bench-bot: Artifacts stored and metadata recorded. Thread archived.
